rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
# As in Debian, the Makefile for the loadable builtins has no folder of the # build in it. What is in the tools folder is looked for in the path. sed -i "s@-ffile-prefix-map=[^ \"']* *@@g" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/bash/Makefile.inc" sed -i -e 's@^BUILD_DIR = .*@BUILD_DIR = /path/to/build-dir@' \ -e "s@$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR@/path/to/source-dir@g" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/bash/Makefile.inc"
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "target" ]; then sed -i 's@/tools/bin/@@g' \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/bash/Makefile.inc" fi
